'''Thakwaa''' was a temperate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] dominated by grassy plains<ref name="UAA" /> that was located in the [[Thakwaa system/Legends|Thakwaa system]] of the [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was an isolated world that attracted little attention from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] until the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="UAA" /> The Empire gave up trying to take over this planet due to [[Thakwaash|its native species']] unpredictable nature's as well as their size and strength, not because the planet was useless.
